svg.title: GATES / LOCKS + SHARED PASSAGES
svg.text: Blender environment reference + editable construction proposal / no meshes or Unity scenes delivered
Full-level image is not a scale drawing.
Concrete straight, corner and side-door modules
Render mesh, blocking collider and selection
Dark roots/shadow barrier is art; a real blocker
Locked gates: blocker enabled, selection trigger
Place the selection trigger beyond the leaf,
without overlap with other route triggers.
show only the winning lock reason.
SELECTED applies only after crossing the actual
Unlock flags are snapshotted at run start;
discoveries do not open current-run C gates.
POWER OFF is an optional E interaction on FERI C,
Meters; Unity +Y up. Floor modules originate on finished floor Y = 0.
Separate render geometry, simple collision and semantic markers.
4 m bays and all new dimensions are proposals; test actual player/camera.
Gate state is independent of route letter. Any A/B/C gate can be locked by context.
Gate names and scene markers in this pack are proposals. Canonical state behavior lives in Gameplay.md §4.
Canonical gameplay: docs/Gameplay.md · source prompts: source-prompts.json · integration: UNITY_WORLD_HANDOFF.md
